* '''PC-E1''' ([[Enhanced Proton Torpedoes (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) took the Heroic starfighter clause out of the parentheses, dropped “first” and changed “total destiny” to “destiny”: “Use 1 Force to deploy on your starfighter. May target a starship for free. Draw destiny. If on a Heroic starfighter, may use 1 Force to add 3 to total. Target hit if destiny > defense value.”.<ref name="cl-1230_118-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
